title: Cocartesian cancellation and initiality of lifts
statement:
Use quasicategories, spaces and initial objects from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and inner fibrations and horn-cocartesian edges from [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Let $p:E\to B$ be an inner fibration of quasicategories. Given a $2$-simplex with edges $u:x\to y$, $v:y\to z$, and $w:x\to z$, if $u$ is $p$-cocartesian, then $v$ is $p$-cocartesian if and only if $w$ is $p$-cocartesian. Every degenerate edge is $p$-cocartesian. For $x\in E$ and an edge $f:p(x)\to b$, form
$$L(x,f)=E_{x/}\times_{B_{p(x)/}}\{f\}.$$
Here $(E_{x/})_n$ consists of maps $\Delta^{n+1}\to E$ with first vertex $x$, with operators induced on the last $n+1$ vertices while keeping the first vertex fixed, and $\{f\}$ is the constant vertex simplicial subset in the corresponding coslice of $B$. Then $L(x,f)$ is a quasicategory, and every $p$-cocartesian lift $x\to y$ of $f$ is initial in $L(x,f)$. A morphism from this lift to another lift $x\to y'$ is a map $y\to y'$ over $1_b$ together with its commuting triangle and all higher data. In particular the universal comparison from one initial lift to another is an equivalence in this lift category; forgetting the triangle gives the corresponding equivalence of targets in $E_b$.
